snippet.title: Shred It! - Teaser Trailer | PS4
snippet.description:
It's Time to Get Back to Paper Nature [Full URL]. Meet an awesome group of boarders, and join them as they hurtle through a gorgeous papercraft world! Brother and sister Parker and Jessie; Frappe the cool snowdude; Rufus a pup who's bark can scare away any critter; Cosmo the space cadet; the crazy Pengz gang - and Erik - the board store owner! 

© Extra Mile Studios 2017
